correctness.rationale: Directly enumerated maximal common-neighbor faces; dominated-vertex collapse makes apex complement contractible and identifies ambient integral H2 with integral H1 of the two-step cycle link via Mayer–Vietoris. Original and shadow deletion maps are calculated by a unit-degree map of circles; exact kernels show which parity summands survive. Two parity-induced spheres map to the integral basis and missing vertices annihilate precisely their coordinates. This proves every W without extrapolating finite GF(2) tests. Boundary n=5 and n=6 are covered; at n=6 the link components are 1-dimensional triangles, not filled faces.

value.rationale: The ordinary Mycielski construction is a canonical chromatic-topology operation; this characterizes all vertex-induced geometric supports of its degree-two integral homology for a natural infinite family. Odd cycles are maximally vertex-essential while even cycles have two explicit primitive half-size parity supports, with a strict full-support requirement for mixed-coordinate classes. These relative lattice invariants are invisible in the familiar ambient suspension homotopy classification and are structurally motivated rather than arbitrary finite parameters.
